within a contracting range between a descending top and a rising bottom. Price is at a similar level on the lower part of the structure, near the $0.09 area.
HBAR Holds Around the Long-Term Support Zone
According to the Inca Investment chart, HBAR is navigating through a significant descending formation that began after the 2025 high at the higher resistance zone.
Price broke below the $0.40 level in the process of making a series of lower highs. Later, the market created support around $0.06-$0.09.

image.alt: HBAR Holds Around the Long-Term Support Zone

children: The chart shows that the current support is around $0.09-$0.10. This area has been an important point of reference in the recent consolidation period. Source: Inca Investments Via X
The current situation has HBAR near the bottom of a long-term triangle. The support line has been continually increasing from its previous support level, which has resulted in a reduced range.
The level of the upper resistance line is close to $0.25-$0.30. Price must navigate this region to alter the bigger picture on the weekly time frame.
Notably, the BraveNewCoin market data displays a broader overview of HBAR price action. It exhibits a long downtrend and a recovery trend, which are in equilibrium at lower price levels.
HBAR Price Structure Shows Recovery Attempts

Notably, the analyst shows that there may be more upward moves to come after this consolidation. The structure shown indicates that the next major support is at $0.15. There is extra resistance around $0.20 and $0.25 above this level.
Also, before this accumulation zone is another zone near the lower range. Price has broken away from that area and established a series of higher lows.

image.alt: HBAR Price Structure Shows Recovery Attempts

children: The chart also has a potential extended bull path to the $0.25 area. This level is also the upper resistance level on the longer time frame chart. Source: Crypto Ryan Via X

The price pattern of HBAR is holding the compression pattern at this moment. The market is moving through the resistance area above the previous bottom area but below the major historical resistance area.
HBAR Price Analysis Tracks Key Breakout Levels

Meanwhile, HBAR price analysis is mainly based on the relationship between support and resistance levels. The support seems to be around $0.09-$0.10, and the resistance levels could be expected at $0.15, $0.20, and $0.25.

image.alt: HBAR Price Analysis Tracks Key Breakout Levels

The previous lower support level will be in focus if the price moves below the $0.09 zone. Previous price action in the charts is around the $0.06 area.
If HBAR is able to breach above $0.15, it will clear the initial $0.15 resistance level on the available charts. The next resistance levels are at $0.20 and $0.25.

The weekly chart reveals that HBAR is continuing its consolidation amid a long-term range. The following pattern is a narrowing, which indicates smaller price movement in comparison to the previous drop.

The provided charts are also displaying market indicators indicating a slow recovery from the prolonged downtrend. Price continues to hover around the bottom of the extended structure as it nears key price levels.

title: HBAR Price Analysis Tracks Recovery Setup After Extended Downtrend
